title: SEC1: bt5.9 admin stats SQL queries wrong pool
description: bt5.9 fixes a timestamp issue in transit/admin.rs. Reviewing the fix: build_stats_json() queries msgid_map and pinned_cids from the transit pool (passed in from main.rs as transit_pool). However, msgid_map lives in the core_pool (transit_core.db), not transit.db. The query 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msgid_map' will return 0 or error silently (SQLite's unwrap_or(0) masks the error) when queried against the transit pool. Articles count in /stats will always read 0 unless the transit pool happens to also have a msgid_map table. This is a silent correctness bug introduced or pre-existing at the admin stats layer. It does not affect article storage but makes the /stats endpoint misleading for operators. Mitigation: pass both pools (core_pool and transit_pool) to start_admin_server, or cross-query correctly.
